channel.title: The Catholic Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Catholic Review (catholicreview.org)

item.title: A look at St. Francis of Assisi on film
item.description: Given the dramatic nature of his conversion and the long-lasting, widespread influence of the family of religious orders he founded, it's no surprise that the life of St. Francis has often been portrayed on film. As early as 1918, a silent Italian production, "Frate Sole" ("Brother Sun"), directed by Ugo Falena, was devoted to the subject.

item.title: What challenges does protesting present in Christian faith? Minnesota panel tackles topic
item.description: A March 5 meeting of legal and other experts at the University of St. Thomas School of Law in Minneapolis considered the topic "Protests and a Christian Response to Government Abuses."

item.title: Pope urges peace, warns about wider Middle East conflict
item.description: Pope Leo XIV called for an end to the war in Iran and warned that the conflict could drag more countries in the Middle East into instability.

item.title: Jesus is close by, so just open your eyes, Pope Leo tells young people
item.description: Every Catholic parish needs to show that Jesus, who promises a just, true and full life, is always near, Pope Leo XIV said.

item.title: Radio Interview: The 2026 Oscars
item.description: Exploring the beauty and challenge of Catholic marriage, this week’s episode of "Catholic Review Radio" features author and homeschooling mother Caitrin Bennett discussing her award-winning book, "Holier Matrimony: Married Saints, Catholic Vows and Sacramental Grace."

item.title: Hagerstown school recognized by Cardinal Newman Society
item.description: St. Mary Catholic School in Hagerstown has been recognized for its Catholic identity and academic excellence by The Cardinal Newman Society.

item.title: Movie Review: ‘Scream 7’
item.description: As its title suggests, "Scream 7" (Paramount) is the latest extension of a long-lived horror franchise, one that's currently approaching its 30th anniversary on screen. Since each chapter of this slasher saga has been a bloodsoaked mess, the series' longevity will strike moviegoers of sense as inexplicable.

item.title: Catholics are urged to be cautious over new Anglican schism
item.description: As bishops and archbishops from the worldwide Anglican Communion sever links with England's first female archbishop of Canterbury, citing her church's "false teaching," Catholics are being urged to maintain friendly ties while dropping illusions about future reunification.

item.title: Christians ‘most persecuted religious community in the world,’ Vatican tells UN
item.description: The Vatican's permanent observer to the United Nations in Geneva called on governments and international organizations to strengthen religious freedom protections for persecuted Christians.

item.title: Lebanese Maronite Catholic priest killed by Israeli tank fire in southern Lebanon
item.description: A Lebanese Maronite Catholic priest has been killed in southern Lebanon when an Israeli artillery tank fired on a house March 9, Catholic officials and media said -- reports that have since been confirmed by OSV News.
